summary.en: QueryPie CEO Brant Hwang and CTO Sam Kim shared insights on the growing security threats posed by AI agents and the strategies enterprises need to use AI safely. They also announced plans to launch AI Gateway as a standalone product, and outlined their vision to support enterprise AI adoption through ACP and AIP while expanding into global markets.

title.en: QueryPie Leadership on the Rise of AI-Driven Threats: 'The Terminator Is No Longer Fiction'
